1.word_for_word: त्रि-चत्वारिंशके हत्वा गजेन्द्रं राम-कृष्णयोः । — In the thirty-fourth century, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa killed the lord of the elephants.; रङ्ग-प्रवेश-सौभाग्यं चाणूरेण च भाषणम् ॥ — The privilege of entering the arena and the speech by Cāṇūra; पूर्वेद्युर् एव कृतं शौचं शुद्धत्वं निरपराधत्वं याभ्यां तौ । — The two of them were purified and cleansed of all sins by performing the rituals performed on the previous day.; एतद् उक्तं भवति, धनुर् भङ्गादिनाऽऽवाभ्यां निजैश्वर्ये सूचितेऽपि पितरौ न मुञ्चत्यावां च पुनर् जिघांसति । — It is said that the bow does not release the fathers even though they have indicated to us that they are in control by breaking the bow and trying to kill us again.; अतोऽस्य मातुलस्यापि वधे नावयोर् दोष इत्य् एवं कृतापराध-परिहाराव् इति । — Therefore, it is not the fault of both of us to kill this maternal uncle.; मल्लानां दुन्दुभीनां च निर्घोषं मल्ल-ताल-दुन्दुभिनिर् घोषं वा ॥१॥ — The sound of the wrestlers and the drums of the wrestlers or the sound of the drums of the wrestlers.
1.translation: In the thirty-fourth century, Rāma and Kṛṣṇa killed the lord of the elephants. The privilege of entering the arena and the speech by Cāṇūra The two of them were purified and cleansed of all sins by performing the rituals performed on the previous day. It is said that the bow does not release the fathers even though they have indicated to us that they are in control by breaking the bow and trying to kill us again. Therefore, it is not the fault of both of us to kill this maternal uncle. The sound of the wrestlers and the drums of the wrestlers or the sound of the drums of the wrestlers.

2.word_for_word: अम्बष्ठो हस्ति-पकस् तेन चोदितम् ॥२॥ — Ambashta, the elephant-cook, was encouraged by him.
2.translation: Ambashta, the elephant-cook, was encouraged by him.

3.word_for_word: परिकरं युद्धोचित-परिधानं कृत्वा । — The equipment was dressed in battle-appropriate clothing.; समुह्य निबध्य ॥३॥ — collectively and bound.
3.translation: The equipment was dressed in battle-appropriate clothing. collectively and bound.

5.word_for_word: अन्तको मृत्युः, कालस् तन् निमित्तम्, यमस् तन् नियन्ता तैर् उपमा यस्य तम् ॥५॥ — The end is death, time is the cause of that, Yama is the controller of that, and they are likened to that.
5.translation: The end is death, time is the cause of that, Yama is the controller of that, and they are likened to that.

6.word_for_word: विगलितो विच्युतः । — He melted and fell apart.; मुष्टिना निहत्य अलीयतादृश्यो बभूव ॥६॥ — He struck him with his fist and appeared to disappear.
6.translation: He melted and fell apart. He struck him with his fist and appeared to disappear.

7.word_for_word: अचक्षाणोऽपश्यन् । — They didn’t see it.; घ्राणम् अवघ्राणं तेन दृष्टिर् दर्शनं यस्य सः । — The sense of smell is the sense of smell, and the sense of sight is the sense of sight.; लोचनागोचरम् अपि हि पशवो घ्राणेन जानन्तीति प्रसिद्धम् । — It is well known that animals recognize by smell even what is visible to the naked eye.; परामृशद् धृतवान् । — He touched it and held it.; पुष्करेण शुण्डाग्रेण । — Pushkara with the tip of the beard.; स कृष्णः । — That’s black.; प्रसह्य बलेन ॥७॥ — by force of force.
7.translation: They didn’t see it. The sense of smell is the sense of smell, and the sense of sight is the sense of sight. It is well known that animals recognize by smell even what is visible to the naked eye. He touched it and held it. Pushkara with the tip of the beard. That’s black. by force of force.

8.word_for_word: धनुषो धनुषां पञ्च-विंशतिर् यावत् तावन्तं देशं विचकर्ष आकृष्य नीतवान् । — The bowman dragged and pulled the country as far as twenty-five bows.; कं क इव विचकर्ष । — He pulled away like a cock.; यथा नागं सर्प-वद् वर्तमानं गजं सुपर्ण-वत् स्वयम् इति, "आविरासीद् यथा प्राच्यां दिशीन्दुर् इव पुष्कलः" इति-वत् ॥८॥ — Just as a serpent acting like a snake and an elephant acting like Garuda itself, "He appeared like the moon in the eastern direction like Pushkala"
8.translation: The bowman dragged and pulled the country as far as twenty-five bows. He pulled away like a cock. Just as a serpent acting like a snake and an elephant acting like Garuda itself, "He appeared like the moon in the eastern direction like Pushkala"

9.word_for_word: स पर्यावर्तमानेनेति । — He is by the one who is turning around.; पुच्छ-ग्राहिणं श्री-कृष्णं ग्रहीतुं यदि दक्षिणतः परिवर्तते गजस् तर्हि सव्यतो भ्रामयति । — If the elephant turns to the right to catch Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is grasping the tail, it turns to the left.; यदा सव्यतः परिवर्तते तदा दक्षिणतो भ्रामयंस् तेन सह बभ्राम । — When he turned left, he turned to the right, and he turned with it.; गो-वत्सेन भ्राम्यमाणेन बालकः स एव कृष्णो यथान्यो वा बालक इवेति ॥९॥ — When a cow and calf are roaming about the child is as black as any other child
9.translation: He is by the one who is turning around. If the elephant turns to the right to catch Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is grasping the tail, it turns to the left. When he turned left, he turned to the right, and he turned with it. When a cow and calf are roaming about the child is as black as any other child

10.word_for_word: वारणं गजं प्राद्रवन् प्रकर्षेणासमन्ततो धावन् पातयाम् आस । — The elephant ran after the elephant and fell down.; यथा पतति तथा तं वञ्चयन् प्राद्रवद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१०॥ — This means that he ran away, deceiving him as he fell.
10.translation: The elephant ran after the elephant and fell down. This means that he ran away, deceiving him as he fell.

11.word_for_word: किं च, स धावन्न् इति । — What’s more, he’s running.; अहनद् अहन् ॥११॥ — Ahanad Ahan.
11.translation: What’s more, he’s running. Ahanad Ahan.

15.word_for_word: रङ्गं समाविशत्, तदा वीर-श्रिया बभौ । — When he entered the arena, he shone with heroic beauty.; कथं भूतः ? — How did it happen?; अंसे न्यस्तं विषाणं गज-दन्तो येन सः । — The elephant-toothed horn placed on his shoulder; असृजो रक्तस्य मदस्य च बिन्दुभिः परितोऽङ्कितः । — Asrija was painted all around with dots of blood and madness.; विरूढा उद्गताः स्वेद-कणिकास् ताभिर् उपलक्षितं वदनाम्बुरुहं यस्य सः ॥१५॥ — The drops of sweat that had fallen off and emerged were marked by the tears on his face.
15.translation: When he entered the arena, he shone with heroic beauty. How did it happen? The elephant-toothed horn placed on his shoulder Asrija was painted all around with dots of blood and madness. The drops of sweat that had fallen off and emerged were marked by the tears on his face.

16.word_for_word: न केवलं स एकः समाविशत्, किन्तु वृतौ गोपैर् इति ॥१६॥ — Not only did he enter alone, but he was surrounded by the cowherd men.
16.translation: Not only did he enter alone, but he was surrounded by the cowherd men.

17.word_for_word: तत्र च शृङ्गारादि-सर्व-रस-कदम्ब-मूर्तिर् भगवान् तत्-तद्-अभिप्रायानुसारेण बभौ, न साकल्येन सर्वेषाम् इत्य् आह---मल्लानाम् इति । — There, too, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the embodiment of all the tastes of beauty and other tastes, appeared according to the intention of each of them, but not of all of them as a whole.; मल्लादीनाम् अज्ञानां द्रष्टॄणाम् अशन्य्-आदि--रूपेण दशधा विदितः सन् साग्रजो रङ्गं गत इत्य् अन्वयः । — The consequence is that he went to the arena with his elder brother, being known in ten forms as Ashany and others to the ignorant spectators of the wrestlers and others.; मल्लादिष्व् अभिव्यक्ता रसाः क्रमेण श्लोका निबध्यन्ते । — The verses are dealt with in order of the tastes expressed in the wrestlers and others.; रौद्रोऽद्भुतश् च शृङ्गारो हास्यं वीरो दया तथा । — He was terrible, wonderful, charming, funny, heroic and kind.; भयानकश् च बीभत्सः शान्तः स-प्रेम-भक्तिकः ॥ — He is terrifying and terrible, peaceful and loving and devoted.; अविदुषां विराट् विकलः पर्याप्तो राजत इति तथा, अनेन बीभत्स-रस उक्तः । — For the ignorant, the vast, separate, sufficient shines, and this is said to be the terrible taste.; विकलत्वं च, क्व वज्र-सार-सर्वाङ्गौ [१०.४४.८] इत्य्-आदिना वक्ष्यते ॥१७॥ — And separateness, where is the essence of the thunderbolt and all its limbs?
17.translation: There, too, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the embodiment of all the tastes of beauty and other tastes, appeared according to the intention of each of them, but not of all of them as a whole. The consequence is that he went to the arena with his elder brother, being known in ten forms as Ashany and others to the ignorant spectators of the wrestlers and others. The verses are dealt with in order of the tastes expressed in the wrestlers and others. He was terrible, wonderful, charming, funny, heroic and kind. He is terrifying and terrible, peaceful and loving and devoted. For the ignorant, the vast, separate, sufficient shines, and this is said to be the terrible taste. And separateness, where is the essence of the thunderbolt and all its limbs?

18.word_for_word: उद्विविजे भीतो बभूव ॥१८॥ — He was frightened and frightened.

19.word_for_word: यथा नटाव् इति निर्भयत्वं दर्शितम् ॥१९॥ — For example, Natav shows that he is fearless.
19.translation: For example, Natav shows that he is fearless.

20.word_for_word: प्रहर्ष-वेगेनोत्कलितान्य् उज्जृम्भितानीक्षणान्य् आननानि च येषाम् । — Their eyes and faces were wide open with the speed of joy.; तयोर् आननं पपुः परं न तृप्ताः । — They drank from their mouths but were not satisfied; निराकाङ्क्षा न बभूवुर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥२०॥ — This means that they did not become desperate.
20.translation: Their eyes and faces were wide open with the speed of joy. They drank from their mouths but were not satisfied This means that they did not become desperate.

21.word_for_word: तद् एवाह---पिबन्त इवेति । — That’s what he said, as if they were drinking.; श्लिष्यन्तः परिष्वङ्गं कुर्वन्त इव लक्षिता इत्य् अर्थः ॥२१॥ — This means that they are seen as if they were embracing each other.
21.translation: That’s what he said, as if they were drinking. This means that they are seen as if they were embracing each other.

22.word_for_word: यथा-दृष्टं धनुर् भङ्गादि, यथा-श्रुतं गोवर्धनोद्धरणादि तत् तद् अनतिक्रम्य, तद् अनुरूपम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that whatever is seen, such as breaking a bow, and whatever is heard, such as lifting a cow, is not transgressed, but corresponds to it.; प्रत्यक्षं च तयो रूपं गज-दन्तादि-युक्तम्, गुणाः शौर्यादयो, माधुर्यं हसितालापादि, प्रागल्भ्यं धार्ष्ट्यं तैः स्मारिता इव स्मरणं प्रापिता इव ॥२२॥ — Their forms were directly manifest with the teeth of elephants and others, their virtues such as valour, sweetness, laughter and conversation, arrogance and cowardice were reminded of them as if they had been reminded of them.
22.translation: This means that whatever is seen, such as breaking a bow, and whatever is heard, such as lifting a cow, is not transgressed, but corresponds to it. Their forms were directly manifest with the teeth of elephants and others, their virtues such as valour, sweetness, laughter and conversation, arrogance and cowardice were reminded of them as if they had been reminded of them.

23.word_for_word: विस्मितानां वाक्यान्य् आह अष्टभिर् एताव् इत्य्-आदिभिः ॥२३॥ — He spoke to the astonished men with eight words, "These are these," and so on.
23.translation: He spoke to the astonished men with eight words, "These are these," and so on.

24.word_for_word: किलेति सर्वत्रान्वयः । — Kile is the consequence everywhere.

25.word_for_word: गुह्यकः शङ्ख-चूडः । — The secret is the conch-shell.; अन्ये चाधासुरादयः ॥२५.२७॥ — Others, such as the Adhasura.
25.translation: The secret is the conch-shell. Others, such as the Adhasura.

28.word_for_word: आश्रमम् ईषच्-छ्रम-युक्तं मुखम् । — The ashram has a slightly slim face.; अश्रमं मुखम् इति वा । — or the face of the asrama.; यद्वा अश्रमं यथा भवति तथा तरन्ति स्मेति ॥२८॥ — Or else they cross the river as it is difficult to do so
28.translation: The ashram has a slightly slim face. or the face of the asrama. Or else they cross the river as it is difficult to do so

29.word_for_word: अनेन परिरक्षितो यदोर् वंशः सु-बहु-विश्रुतः सन् श्र्य्-आदि लप्स्यत इति वदन्तीति ॥२९॥ — It is said that the Yadu dynasty protected by this will become very famous and will attain prosperity and so on.
29.translation: It is said that the Yadu dynasty protected by this will become very famous and will attain prosperity and so on.

30.word_for_word: धेनुक-बक-वत्सासुरेषु विपर्ययोक्तिर् जन-वादेष्व् अरिश् चयात् ॥३०॥ — The opposite of cows, goats, calves and demons is the cause of the enemy in the arguments of the people.
30.translation: The opposite of cows, goats, calves and demons is the cause of the enemy in the arguments of the people.

31.word_for_word: जनेष्व् एवं ब्रुवाणेषु सत्सु तद् असहमानश् चाणूरोऽब्रवीद् इति ॥३१.३४॥ — While the virtuous people were thus speaking Cāṇūra, unable to tolerate this, said
31.translation: While the virtuous people were thus speaking Cāṇūra, unable to tolerate this, said

35.word_for_word: हे कृष्ण, प्रियं करवामेति । — O Krishna, let us do what pleases you.; राज्ञि प्रीते भूतानि च प्रसीदेयुः ॥३५.३७॥ — When the queen is pleased all beings should be pleased.
35.translation: O Krishna, let us do what pleases you. When the queen is pleased all beings should be pleased.

38.word_for_word: यथोचितं नियुद्धं वाहु-युद्धं भवेत् । — There should be an arm-wrestling fight as appropriate.; मल्ल-सभा-सदो मल्ल-सभाधिकृतान् जनान् अधर्मो मा स्पृशेन् न स्पृशेद् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that iniquity should not touch or touch the people who are always in the wrestling assembly.; हे मल्लेति वा ॥३८॥ — or, O wrestler.
38.translation: There should be an arm-wrestling fight as appropriate. This means that iniquity should not touch or touch the people who are always in the wrestling assembly. or, O wrestler.

39.word_for_word: सहस्र-द्विपानां सत्त्वं बलं बिभर्तीति तथा ॥३९॥ — It also carries the strength of a thousand elephants
39.translation: It also carries the strength of a thousand elephants

40.word_for_word: बलिभिर् मादृशैः सह । — With victims like me.; अनयोऽधर्मः विक्रम पराक्रमं कुरु । — These are irreligious things, O Vikrama, please be valiant.; मुष्टिको विक्रमताद् इत्य् अनुषङ्गः ॥४०॥ — The fist is attached to the prowess.
40.translation: With victims like me. These are irreligious things, O Vikrama, please be valiant. The fist is attached to the prowess.
